pages.title: Straight into the Bag
pages.text: Install a pickup upgrade and let it collect at least one dropped item into the backpack.

pages.title: Straight into the Bag
pages.text: Make automatic pickup serve your trips.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Install and enable the upgrade in the backpack. Drop an ordinary spare item nearby and check that it enters the backpack itself.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Install/enable Pickup and collect a permitted ground item on contact; filtering selects contents and advanced adds comparisons.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Magnet attracts permitted ground items from range rather than requiring contact. Range and filters follow native configuration.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Storage Pickup/Magnet collect/attract eligible items into placed storage using that wrapper range/filter.
